caption: Figure 4: Network view definition example A CANIF105: The CAN Interface supports multiple networks. These have to be distinguished by upper layers for network control. The CAN Interface API provides request and read control for multiple underlying CAN networks. CANIF067: If more than one CAN controller operates at a single CAN network (), the CAN Interface handles these CAN controllers in same manner. That means during initialization the CAN Interface initiates initialization for all these CAN controllers. As well re-initialization during BusOff-Recovery is performed always on all CAN controllers connected to the same network. CANIF169: Moreover the CAN Interface does not consider dedicated network types (i.e. low-speed CAN or high-speed CAN), to which one or multiple CAN controllers are connected.
